en.setting: Crale Orchard lies at the edge of a quiet English village, its stone walls and hedgerows dividing land that has been fought over for generations. The evening light fades early here, and the boundary markers cast long shadows across disputed ground.
en.crime: Jonas Fell, a land surveyor, was found dead beside the western boundary stone at dawn. His notebook lay open and his lamp glass was broken.

suspects.name: Thomas Crale
suspects.intro: Owner of the orchard and farmhouse, burdened by debts that exceed the value of his land.

suspects.name: Amos Webb
suspects.intro: A neighbouring farmer who filed the complaint that triggered the boundary inspection.

suspects.name: Ruth Crale
suspects.intro: Thomas's wife, quiet and guarded, with knowledge of the family's financial ruin.

suspects.name: Mr Hadley
suspects.intro: A local man with physical access to the orchard and familiarity with its tools.

suspects.name: Ned Garvey
suspects.intro: A villager seen drinking with Fell at the inn on the afternoon of his death.

suspects.name: Eliza Banks
suspects.intro: A prospective buyer who had offered to purchase the orchard at auction.

suspects.name: Constable Price
suspects.intro: The local constable who discovered the body, with access to the scene before anyone else.

es.setting: El huerto de Crale se encuentra en las afueras de un tranquilo pueblo ingles, con muros de piedra y setos que dividen tierras disputadas durante generaciones. La luz del atardecer se desvanece temprano, y los mojones proyectan largas sombras sobre el terreno en litigio.
es.crime: Jonas Fell, un agrimensor, fue hallado muerto junto a la piedra del lindero oeste al amanecer. Su cuaderno estaba abierto y el cristal de su lampara, roto.

suspects.name: Thomas Crale
suspects.intro: Propietario del huerto y la granja, agobiado por deudas que superan el valor de su tierra.

suspects.name: Amos Webb
suspects.intro: Un granjero vecino que presento la queja que desencadeno la inspeccion de linderos.

suspects.name: Ruth Crale
suspects.intro: La esposa de Thomas, reservada y cautelosa, conocedora de la ruina financiera familiar.

suspects.name: Mr Hadley
suspects.intro: Un hombre local con acceso fisico al huerto y familiaridad con sus herramientas.

suspects.name: Ned Garvey
suspects.intro: Un aldeano visto bebiendo con Fell en la posada la tarde de su muerte.

suspects.name: Eliza Banks
suspects.intro: Una compradora potencial que habia ofrecido adquirir el huerto en subasta.

suspects.name: Constable Price
suspects.intro: El agente local que descubrio el cuerpo, con acceso a la escena antes que nadie.

fr.setting: Le verger de Crale se trouve en bordure d'un paisible village anglais, ses murs de pierre et ses haies divisant des terres disputees depuis des generations. La lumiere du soir s'estompe tot ici, et les bornes projettent de longues ombres sur le terrain conteste.
fr.crime: Jonas Fell, un geometre, a ete retrouve mort a l'aube pres de la borne ouest. Son carnet etait ouvert et le verre de sa lampe, brise.

suspects.name: Thomas Crale
suspects.intro: Proprietaire du verger et de la ferme, accable par des dettes depassant la valeur de ses terres.

suspects.name: Amos Webb
suspects.intro: Un fermier voisin qui a depose la plainte ayant declenche l'inspection des limites.

suspects.name: Ruth Crale
suspects.intro: L'epouse de Thomas, discrete et sur ses gardes, au fait de la ruine financiere familiale.

suspects.name: Mr Hadley
suspects.intro: Un homme du coin ayant acces au verger et connaissant bien ses outils.

suspects.name: Ned Garvey
suspects.intro: Un villageois vu en train de boire avec Fell a l'auberge l'apres-midi de sa mort.

suspects.name: Eliza Banks
suspects.intro: Une acheteuse potentielle qui avait propose d'acquerir le verger aux encheres.

suspects.name: Constable Price
suspects.intro: L'agent local qui a decouvert le corps, ayant eu acces a la scene avant quiconque.

all_strong.en: Thomas Crale broke under the weight of the parish ledger and the iron pry bar found in his shed. He had moved the boundary stones by night, redrawn the map, and killed the one man whose measurements would have exposed the fraud. The debt, the forged deed, the altered path — every thread led back to the farmhouse at the edge of the orchard. The jury deliberated for less than an hour.
all_strong.es: Thomas Crale se derrumbo bajo el peso del libro parroquial y la palanca de hierro hallada en su cobertizo. Habia movido los mojones de noche, redibujado el mapa y matado al unico hombre cuyas mediciones habrian expuesto el fraude. La deuda, la escritura falsificada, el sendero alterado: cada hilo conducia a la granja al borde del huerto. El jurado delibero menos de una hora.
all_strong.fr: Thomas Crale a craque sous le poids du registre paroissial et de la barre de fer trouvee dans sa remise. Il avait deplace les bornes de nuit, redessine la carte et tue le seul homme dont les mesures auraient revele la fraude. La dette, l'acte falsifie, le chemin modifie — chaque fil ramenait a la ferme en bordure du verger. Le jury a delibere moins d'une heure.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Everyone in the village knew Thomas Crale had reason to fear the surveyor's report. But knowing and proving are different matters. The boundary stones told one story, the parish records another, and neither could be made to speak clearly in court. Crale was charged, but the case rested on suspicion more than evidence. The conviction came thin and unsatisfying, like winter light through orchard branches.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: Todos en el pueblo sabian que Thomas Crale tenia razones para temer el informe del agrimensor. Pero saber y probar son cosas distintas. Los mojones contaban una historia, los registros parroquiales otra, y ninguno pudo hablar con claridad ante el tribunal. Crale fue acusado, pero el caso se sostuvo mas en sospechas que en pruebas. La condena llego debil e insatisfactoria, como la luz invernal entre las ramas del huerto.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Tout le village savait que Thomas Crale avait des raisons de craindre le rapport du geometre. Mais savoir et prouver sont deux choses differentes. Les bornes racontaient une histoire, les registres paroissiaux une autre, et aucun ne put parler clairement devant le tribunal. Crale fut inculpe, mais l'affaire reposait davantage sur des soupcons que sur des preuves. La condamnation tomba, mince et insatisfaisante, comme la lumiere d'hiver a travers les branches du verger.

wrong_accusation.en: The inspector pointed the finger at the wrong man, and the real killer watched from the farmhouse window as an innocent was led away. Thomas Crale remained free, the boundary stayed where he had moved it, and Jonas Fell's notebook gathered dust in an evidence locker. The orchard kept its stolen acres, and the truth sank into the soil like autumn rain.
wrong_accusation.es: El inspector senalo al hombre equivocado, y el verdadero asesino observo desde la ventana de la granja mientras se llevaban a un inocente. Thomas Crale quedo libre, el lindero permanecio donde el lo habia movido, y el cuaderno de Jonas Fell acumulo polvo en un deposito de pruebas. El huerto conservo sus acres robados, y la verdad se hundio en la tierra como la lluvia de otono.
wrong_accusation.fr: L'inspecteur a designe le mauvais homme, et le veritable tueur a regarde depuis la fenetre de la ferme tandis qu'un innocent etait emmene. Thomas Crale est reste libre, la limite est restee la ou il l'avait deplacee, et le carnet de Jonas Fell a pris la poussiere dans un casier a preuves. Le verger a garde ses acres voles, et la verite s'est enfoncee dans le sol comme la pluie d'automne.

cold_case.en: The file on Jonas Fell's death was never closed, merely set aside. The boundary dispute faded from parish conversation, the orchard changed hands quietly, and the surveyor's name was forgotten by everyone except the postman who had seen him walk toward the trees that last afternoon. The stones stood where they had been placed, and no one measured the distance again.
cold_case.es: El expediente sobre la muerte de Jonas Fell nunca se cerro, simplemente se archivo. La disputa de linderos se desvanecio de las conversaciones parroquiales, el huerto cambio de manos en silencio, y el nombre del agrimensor fue olvidado por todos excepto el cartero que lo vio caminar hacia los arboles aquella ultima tarde. Las piedras permanecieron donde habian sido colocadas, y nadie volvio a medir la distancia.
cold_case.fr: Le dossier sur la mort de Jonas Fell n'a jamais ete clos, simplement mis de cote. Le litige foncier s'est efface des conversations paroissiales, le verger a change de mains discretement, et le nom du geometre a ete oublie par tous sauf le facteur qui l'avait vu marcher vers les arbres cet ultime apres-midi. Les pierres sont restees la ou elles avaient ete placees, et personne n'a mesure la distance a nouveau.

lucky_guess.en: Thomas Crale's name came up almost by accident, and there was just enough to hold him. But the case was gossamer — a hunch dressed in circumstance. The parish whispered that justice had been done, but the evidence locker held more questions than answers. Crale went to trial on the strength of a guess, and the orchard stood silent on the matter.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre de Thomas Crale surgio casi por accidente, y habia justo lo suficiente para retenerlo. Pero el caso era fragil como una telarana: una corazonada vestida de circunstancia. La parroquia susurraba que se habia hecho justicia, pero el deposito de pruebas guardaba mas preguntas que respuestas. Crale fue a juicio por la fuerza de una suposicion, y el huerto guardo silencio al respecto.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom de Thomas Crale est apparu presque par accident, et il y avait tout juste assez pour le retenir. Mais l'affaire etait fragile comme une toile d'araignee — une intuition habillee de circonstances. La paroisse murmurait que justice avait ete rendue, mais le casier a preuves contenait plus de questions que de reponses. Crale est passe en jugement sur la force d'une supposition, et le verger est reste muet sur la question.

expressions.suspect:thomas_crale: Thomas Crale leaned on the gate with his arms folded. His boots were clean but the cuffs of his trousers carried dried clay.
expressions.event:altered_path: The boundary path had been moved twelve feet to the south. The old line was still visible as a depression in the grass.
expressions.motive:boundary_fraud: The altered boundary added four acres to the Crale holding. The extra land covered the shortfall on his debt to the bank.
expressions.suspect:amos_webb: Amos Webb farmed the adjoining field and had quarrelled with Fell over access. His dog was loose in the orchard that evening.
expressions.suspect:ruth_crale: Ruth Crale served tea to the inspector and said nothing about the boundary. Her hands were steady but her eyes did not leave the window.
expressions.suspect:mr_hadley: Mr Hadley was the parish surveyor and had measured the boundary the previous year. His original notes differ from the filed record.
expressions.suspect:ned_garvey: Ned Garvey drank with Jonas Fell at the village inn on the afternoon of the death. He said Fell mentioned a discrepancy in the maps.
expressions.suspect:eliza_banks: Eliza Banks kept the parish records and filed the land deeds. She had placed a rival bid on the orchard six months earlier.
expressions.suspect:constable_price: Constable Price was first to reach the body at dawn. He noted the position of the stakes before anyone else arrived.
expressions.location:crale_orchard: The orchard covers three acres on a south-facing slope above the river. The oldest trees are bare and the grass is long between the rows.
expressions.location:boundary_wall: The boundary wall runs along the western edge of the orchard. One section of stone has been rebuilt with fresh mortar.
expressions.location:farm_lane: The farm lane connects the orchard gate to the village road. Wheel ruts and boot prints cross in both directions.
expressions.location:parish_office: The parish office holds land records going back to 1804. The filing cabinet nearest the window holds current boundary maps.
expressions.location:crale_farmhouse: The farmhouse sits fifty yards from the orchard gate. A light burned in the kitchen window until after midnight.
expressions.location:village_inn: The village inn serves as courthouse and public house. Jonas Fell signed his last letter there at four in the afternoon.
expressions.location:tool_shed: The tool shed stands behind the farmhouse wall. An iron pry bar hangs from a nail beside the door.
expressions.location:river_crossing: The river crossing lies below the orchard at the bottom of the slope. The stepping stones are slippery after rain.
expressions.object:survey_stakes: Three wooden survey stakes stand at the new boundary line. The paint is fresh and the wood has not yet weathered.
expressions.object:boundary_map: The boundary map in the parish office shows the Crale holding twelve feet wider than the 1921 survey. The ink colour differs at the western edge.
expressions.object:iron_pry_bar: An iron pry bar was found in the tool shed with soil on its end. The bar matches the marks on the displaced boundary stone.
expressions.object:parish_ledger: The parish ledger records all boundary amendments by date and witness. The latest entry has a single witness signature.
expressions.object:debt_notice: A bank notice addressed to Thomas Crale was found in the farmhouse bureau. The outstanding sum matches the value of four acres.
expressions.object:fell_notebook: Jonas Fell's field notebook was found beside the body with three pages torn out. The remaining pages show measurements that contradict the filed map.
expressions.object:moved_stone: A boundary stone has been levered from its original position and re-seated. The base shows a ring of fresh mortar.
expressions.object:boot_scraping: Boot scrapings on the orchard gate post match a size eleven sole. Amos Webb wears size eleven.
expressions.object:rope_fragment: A length of rope was found tied to the boundary stone. The fibres match the rope stock in Crale's tool shed.
expressions.object:land_deed: The land deed for the Crale orchard was refiled at the parish office four months ago. The new filing adds four acres to the western boundary.
expressions.object:lamp_glass: A broken lamp glass was found at the base of the boundary wall. The oil had soaked into the grass beneath it.
expressions.object:soil_sample: Soil from the boundary stone base does not match the surrounding ground. The clay is consistent with the riverbank below the orchard.
expressions.object:chain_measure: Fell's surveyor chain was found fully extended between two stakes. The measurement reads twelve feet longer than the filed record.
expressions.emotion:guarded_calm: He answered each question about the boundary with the same flat tone. His pipe remained unlit in his hand.
expressions.emotion:quick_anger: Webb stood up from his chair when the boundary was mentioned. He sat down again without being asked.
expressions.emotion:false_sympathy: Crale spoke of Fell as a thorough man and a loss to the county. He did not mention that Fell had written to the bank.
expressions.emotion:stiff_silence: Hadley looked at the filed map and said nothing for twelve seconds. He then asked whether the original survey still existed.
expressions.emotion:nervous_laughter: She laughed once when asked about the refiled deed. The sound stopped abruptly and she reached for her tea.
expressions.emotion:flat_denial: He said he arrived at dawn and found the body exactly as it lay. His account did not change across three tellings.
expressions.modifier:stake_repositioned: The western survey stakes stand twelve feet south of the depression left by the original markers. The soil around each stake is loose.
expressions.modifier:fresh_mortar: The mortar joining the re-seated boundary stone is a lighter colour than the rest of the wall. It has not yet fully cured.
expressions.modifier:mud_on_handle: The pry bar handle carries dried mud matching the orchard topsoil. The grip pattern is consistent with a bare right hand.
expressions.modifier:lamp_extinguished: The lamp was found with its glass broken and the wick cold. Oil pooled beneath it suggests it fell from a height.
expressions.modifier:gate_unlocked: The orchard gate was found unlatched at dawn. Crale stated he locked it at six the previous evening.
expressions.modifier:ink_alteration: The boundary line on the parish map is drawn in two inks. The western section is darker and applied with a finer nib.
expressions.modifier:soil_disturbed: The soil around the boundary stone base is loose and mixed with clay. The clay does not occur naturally at that elevation.
expressions.modifier:rope_knotted: The rope around the boundary stone is tied in a bowline. Crale served in the merchant navy where the bowline is standard.
expressions.modifier:bruise_pattern: The bruise on Fell's temple is consistent with the flat end of a pry bar. The angle suggests a blow from the right.
expressions.modifier:boot_print: Boot prints near the body match a size eleven sole with a worn left heel. Webb and Garvey both wear size eleven.
expressions.action:stone_levered: The boundary stone was levered from its bed using an iron bar. The leverage marks match the tool shed pry bar.
expressions.action:map_redrawn: The parish map was amended by hand with a darker ink. The amendment was not countersigned by a second surveyor.
expressions.action:path_cleared: The original boundary path was cleared of its markers and the grass combed flat. Only the soil depression remains.
expressions.action:ledger_amended: The parish ledger entry for the Crale boundary shows a correction in different ink. The witness column has one signature instead of two.
expressions.action:drink_offered: Ned Garvey bought Fell a pint at four and they spoke for an hour. Garvey said Fell seemed worried but did not say about what.
expressions.action:gate_opened: The orchard gate was unlatched from inside using the drop bolt. The bolt is stiff and requires force to lift.
expressions.action:deed_filed: The refiled deed was submitted by Eliza Banks on behalf of Crale. The original deed has not been returned.
expressions.action:notebook_removed: Three pages were torn from Fell's notebook after the measurements were taken. The tear marks suggest haste.
expressions.action:rope_cut: The rope was cut six inches from the knot with a sharp blade. The cut is clean and made in a single stroke.
expressions.time:dusk_hour: Fell was last seen alive at the boundary wall shortly before dusk. The light was failing and he carried a lamp.
expressions.time:afternoon_survey: Fell began his survey of the Crale boundary at two in the afternoon. He worked alone with his chain and notebook.
expressions.time:morning_discovery: Constable Price found the body at first light beside the boundary stone. The dew had settled and the grass was undisturbed around the path.
expressions.time:filing_deadline: The bank required proof of acreage by the end of the month. Without the extra four acres, the debt exceeded the collateral.
expressions.time:last_light: The sun set at half past five and the orchard was dark within the hour. No lamp was seen from the farm lane after six.
expressions.motive:land_debt: Crale owed the bank more than the farm was worth at its current size. The four extra acres brought the collateral above the debt.
expressions.motive:acreage_claim: The amended boundary gave Crale a strip of rich bottomland along the river. The strip had been common grazing for thirty years.
expressions.motive:survey_suppression: Fell's survey would have revealed the boundary had been moved. His report was due at the parish office the following morning.
expressions.motive:family_name: The Crale family had held the orchard for three generations. Losing it to the bank would end a name in the parish register.
expressions.motive:rival_bid: Eliza Banks had offered to buy the orchard at auction six months earlier. If Crale defaulted, she was positioned to acquire it.
expressions.witness:postman_ridge: The postman saw Fell walking toward the orchard at two with his chain over his shoulder. He did not see anyone else on the lane.
expressions.witness:milk_boy: The milk boy passed the orchard gate at half past five in the morning. The gate was open and he saw no lamp or figure.
expressions.witness:vicar: The vicar spoke with Fell at the inn before the survey. Fell said he expected the measurements would not match the filed record.
expressions.witness:inn_landlord: The inn landlord served Fell and Garvey at four. He said Fell left at five with his bag and did not return.
expressions.witness:ploughman: The ploughman worked the field below the river crossing until dark. He heard nothing from the orchard above.
expressions.event:jonas_fell_discovered: Jonas Fell was found beside the western boundary stone at dawn. His notebook lay open and his lamp glass was broken.
expressions.event:boundary_inspection: The boundary inspection was ordered by the parish council after a complaint from Amos Webb. Fell was appointed to conduct it.
